title: The Great Dictator
synopsis: A Jewish barber, an identical dictator, a balloon globe in an office, and a microphone that changes hands at the worst possible moment.

nodes.text: A long gun, a comrade, the wrong line of the parapet.

choices.consequence: The decision settles the question for now. Its verdict—Mercy—follows you into whatever comes next.
There is no taking “Fire” back. Soldier shapes the silence before the next moment arrives.

nodes.text: Generations later you wake up in a hospital that no longer exists.

choices.consequence: There is no taking “Walk home” back. Stubborn shapes the silence before the next moment arrives.
There is no taking “Wait” back. Cautious shapes the silence before the next moment arrives.

nodes.text: Dust, a sign, a customer with a Hynkel armband at the door.

choices.consequence: The choice lands, and the scene changes around it. If it has a name, that name is Wise.
You commit to “Refuse to serve.” The story records the instinct as “Brave” and carries it forward.

nodes.text: A pan of soup, a courtyard, a hope that survived a war.

choices.consequence: There is no taking “Talk to her” back. Heart shapes the silence before the next moment arrives.
“Hide” closes one possibility and opens another. The moment leaves a clear note behind: Shy.

nodes.text: A pilot you carried out of a burning fuselage in another life.

choices.consequence: “Greet him” closes one possibility and opens another. The moment leaves a clear note behind: Honor.
You let the choice stand. The path shifts almost imperceptibly, marked by one lasting impulse: Wise.

Some endings reveal themselves last.

nodes.text: The crowd is quiet for once, and somewhere a woman on a hillside stands up. The film cuts to her face, and the future is, for one second, possible.
You return to the chair and the strop, and a man in an armband comes in to threaten you and finds Schultz waiting for him, smiling.
She knocks at your shop a year after the war and you do not recognize her at first, both of you laughing at how thin you became.
